Roam the Seas at Your Speed

Out here, we steer the ship but leave the rest up to you.

Vacation Exactly How You Want To

Introducing Norwegian Bella! Our newest ship feels like it was made just for you. On board, you and everyone you travel with can vacation without compromise. Discover exciting new spaces and experience a vacation like never before. 

  • Discover More

Great Tides Waterpark: Now Open

Experience the epic Great Tides Waterpark at Great Stirrup Cay, where little ones make a splash, thrill-seekers conquer towering slides, and everyone finds their ultimate island day.

  • Learn More

Get a FREE $150 Credit with CruiseFirst

For a limited time only stack up your savings towards a future cruise on 3+ day sailings.

  • Learn More
OUR BIGGEST, BOLDEST SPLASH. EVER.

Now Open! Great Tides Waterpark at Great Stirrup Cay

When you cruise to Great Stirrup Cay, you can be among the first to experience Great Tides Waterpark. Only here can you spend the day on a private island and take on towering slides in the Caribbean, leap into the water from Cliffside Cove, float through the Wandering River and still unwind along turquoise shores sipping your favorite cocktail. It’s everything you love about a beach escape with the thrill of a world-class waterpark.

  • Learn More
  • View Cruises

It’s Different Out Here

At Norwegian Cruise Line, we believe a vacation should be a break from the norm. From the schedules, obligations and itineraries that dictate our day-to-days. We believe you should be given space to breathe and taste all the flavors of our world-class dining. To feel all the textures of our stylish accommodations, to take in the extravagance of our world-class entertainment, to stroll all the corners of our ship and port stops. Out here, you deserve to relish.

  • Learn More

The Flow of Things On Board

Out here, the best vacations don’t follow a script. We don’t tell you what to do, just what you can do, so that however you go about your days is completely up to you.

  • Learn More

Crush Cravings

  • Global Cuisine

Cruiser's Choice

  • Unparalleled Activities

Kick Back

  • Stylish Staterooms

Loosen Up

  • Award-winning Spa

See Something

  • World-Class Entertainment

Go All Out While You're Far Out

Get anything and everything you want with one of the ocean’s most expansive packages, Free at Sea™. From an unlimited open bar and Wi-Fi connection to craving-crushing restaurants and shore excursion credits at every stop, satisfy your every whim whenever the breeze blows it in.

  • Learn More

Everywhere You Want to Go and Nowhere You Don't

Select a destination and discover the ports of call that get you there.

See All Destinations

Grand Bahama Island

Kayak through mangroves, swim with pigs, and explore delightful cafés.

Great Stirrup Cay

NCL's private island has white-sand beaches,  luxe cabanas, and endless activities.

Nassau

Swim with dolphins, shop for deals, and discover pastel-colored buildings.

Bimini

Thrilling activities, expansive beaches, and deep-sea fishing.
Learn About The Bahamas

Harvest Caye, Belize

Exclusive NCL resort with lush rainforests and a world-famous coral reef.

Cozumel, Mexico

Stunning island with world-class snorkeling, Mayan Ruins, and a charming town.

St. Thomas, USVI

Sail a catamaran, snorkel a shipwreck, and relax on white-sand beaches.

Roatán, Honduras

Eco-tourism, a sprawling coral reef, and delicious street food.
Learn About The Caribbean

Icy Strait Point

Native land full of adventure, where wildlife outnumbers humans.

Skagway

Discover Gold Rush history, ride the White Pass railway, see the Yukon Route.

Juneau

Majestic glaciers, supreme kayaking & flightseeing, and a historic downtown.

Ketchikan

Spot an eagle or catch a salmon in this lush wilderness.
Learn About Alaska

Royal Navy Dockyard, Bermuda

From British-style high tea to teeing it up on the greens, experience your island escape.

Boston

Welcome to an American city where history truly does come to life.

New York

Everyone loves New York and there are a million reasons why. 

Philadelphia

Visit Philadelphia, a city at the heart of the United States' earliest days.

Cabo San Lucas

Dramatic rock formations, abundant marine life and vibrant markets.

Puerto Vallarta

Hiking, mountainbiking, open-air markets, and inviting beaches.

Ensenada

Wine tasting, laid-back atmosphere and a world-famous geyser.

Mazatlán

Explore a famed lighthouse plus numerous beaches, mountains & margaritas.
Learn About Mexican Riviera

Hilo

Dramatic waterfalls, an active volcano, and tropical flowers at every turn.

Kona

Tropical marine life, fantastic surfing, world-class coffee and Hawaiian history.

Kahului

World-famous kitesurfing, soaring mountains, and genuine hospitality.

Nāwiliwili

Rich landscapes, lush rainforests and postcard-perfect beaches.
Learn About Hawaii

Reykjavik, Iceland

Geothermal wonders, Viking history, stunning architecture, and endless charm.

Amsterdam, Netherlands

Beautiful canals, iconic museums, memorable cuisine and exciting nightlife.

Bruges, Belgium

Baroque design, modern museums, upscale shops and delicious chocolate.

Helsinki, Finland

Innovative design, sustainable outdoor spaces and Art Nouveau architecture.
Learn About Northern Europe

Get Familiar with Our Fleet

Award-winning ships that bring a different experience to cruising around the world with endless dining, entertainment and experience options. 

Your Choice of Accommodations

From solo studios to The Haven’ s luxurious suites hidden away in an exclusive enclave, we’ve got spaces to choose from that feels right for you and yours.

  • See Details

Ships Driven to be Different

Set sail on ships that take your leisure seriously with spaces for relaxation and limitless activities, all built around your schedule.

  • See Details

Meet Our Newest Ship at Sea

Norwegian Luna™ is the newest ship sailing the Caribbean. Feel the rush of the Aqua Slidecoaster, swim on top of the ocean in the infinity pools, and enjoy dinner with a moonlit stroll on Ocean Boulevard. Norwegian Luna sparkles, day or night.

  • See Details
